# The Hub Louisville

> Nightclub at 1133 Bardstown Road in the Highlands, Louisville, Kentucky 40204. Latin Night every Friday and a club night every Saturday, 10PM to 4AM. Local DJs, multiple dance floors, a patio, craft cocktails, VIP bottle service, and private event space. 21+ with valid ID. English and Spanish site.

## Weekly nights

- [Latin Night — every Friday](https://hublouisville.com/latin-night): 10PM–4AM. Resident DJ Seizure with DJ VK. Reggaeton, bachata, salsa and Latin hits. VIP booths available. Spanish: [Noche Latina](https://hublouisville.com/es/noche-latina)
- [Saturday Night — every Saturday](https://hublouisville.com/saturday-night): 10PM–4AM. DJ Junior and DJ Perry, multiple dance floors, patio. VIP booths available. Spanish: [Sábado](https://hublouisville.com/es/sabado)

Open Friday and Saturday nights only for the public. Sunday–Thursday the venue is available for private events.

## VIP bottle service

- [Request a VIP table](https://hublouisville.com/vip-service) · [Bottle service menu (PDF)](https://hublouisville.com/bottle-service-menu.pdf)
- 2-bottle minimum per booth, 20% gratuity added automatically.
- Booth arrival between 11:00PM and 12:30AM. Reservation confirmed once management secures a card.
- $150 cancellation fee with less than 48 hours' notice. Booth decoration available for $120.
- Includes skip-the-line entry, guaranteed seating and a dedicated server.

## Birthdays

- [Text list signup](https://hublouisville.com/text): no cover for you plus 9 friends during your birthday week.

## Private events

- [Private events](https://hublouisville.com/private-events): any night Sunday–Thursday, or Friday/Saturday until 10PM. Lounge, cocktail or dance-party layouts, custom cocktails, preferred caterers, event manager.
